research_rule: Математика не сходится. Пока не сойдется.
pre_freeze_development_finding: Generic flat bucket elimination on a single chain-connected internal component caused factor scope to grow with k: prototype max scopes 7,10,13,16,19,22 and paid enumeration work approximately 704,4672,27264,204160,1627328,12642240 for k=6,9,12,15,18,21. Therefore v8 tests state-on-cut representation rather than flattening all internals away.
hypothesis: A single growing internal component can still compile to a small exact boundary message when its block-cut graph has narrow articulation separators. JANUS should preserve small existential cut states inside a trellis representation instead of flattening the boundary relation into one factor.
generator: Chain cyclic non-affine blocks. Consecutive blocks are coupled by exact equality between the previous block's z internal and the next block's s internal, making one growing internal connected component.
solver_input: Obfuscated CNF plus supplied boundary variables only; no block labels, equality-link labels, generator family or expected relation.
trellis_compiler: Detect exact internal equality pairs from reciprocal binary clauses and canonicalize them by union-find.
Build the normalized primal graph from actual clauses.
Compute biconnected components and articulation vertices without generator metadata.
Each biconnected bag is compiled by exact local existential enumeration of non-articulation internals while retaining incident articulation variables as hidden trellis states.

Output is a conjunction tree/DAG of exact local factors over boundary variables plus hidden state identifiers. External interface remains boundary; state variables are existentially internal to the compiled message.
TruthGate rebuilds canonical bags/factors independently and compares hashes.
baselines: FLAT_BUCKET_ELIMINATION: generic factor-table elimination that fully eliminates all internals into boundary-only factors.
GLOBAL_ROBDD: min-fill ROBDD build and existential quantification from v6.

gates.T1_EXACTNESS_AND_REPLAY: 100% trellis messages replay; independent evaluation-only audit versus exact global ROBDD agrees on every boundary assignment for the frozen k<=15 ladder.
gates.T2_ONE_GROWING_INTERNAL_COMPONENT: Before equality normalization each case has one internal connected component whose size grows with k.
gates.T3_ARTICULATION_STATE_DISCOVERY: Articulation states and bags are discovered from the normalized primal graph; no hidden block IDs. Median max bag external scope <=5.
gates.T4_ZERO_SOLVER_GLOBAL_ENUMERATION: Trellis construction enumerates no global 2^k boundary assignments.
gates.T5_COMPACT_TRELLIS: For k>=9 median trellis serialized bytes / 2^k <=0.15 and factor-node adjacent growth <=1.75.
gates.T6_STATE_ON_CUT_SCALING: Adjacent median trellis paid work growth <=2.0 on +3 boundary bits.
gates.T7_ESCAPE_FLAT_BUCKET: For k>=12 median trellis paid work / flat-bucket work <=0.20.
gates.T8_ESCAPE_GLOBAL_ROBDD: For k>=12 median trellis paid work / global-ROBDD paid work <=0.35.
gates.T9_FULL_ACCOUNTING: Local enumeration, state count, bag scope, baseline work and evaluation-only audit are separate ledgers.
gates.T10_UNIVERSAL_POLYNOMIAL_BOUNDARY_ELIMIN: OPEN unless arbitrary-CNF formal polynomial bounds are proved.
